leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Ascension Automation Solutions is a Cambridge, Ontario industrial-automation company that designs, builds, commissions and supports robotic, machine-vision and controls systems for manufacturing environments. Ascension Automation provides end-to-end industrial automation including robot and controls programming, machine vision, welding systems, bin-picking, inspection and product-development services. FedDev Ontario's July 2026 backgrounder documents an investment in Ascension Automation's new fully automated production hub and identifies its industrial-automation specialization, including robotics, system design, build, commissioning and service.
